# scheduler

A Helm chart for caipe-scheduler - cron schedule registry + k8s CronJob orchestrator. Owns the only RBAC permission to create batch/v1 CronJobs from a hard-coded podTemplate.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Version** | `0.5.68` |
| **Type** | application |

## Quick Start

```bash
# Add and install the chart
helm install scheduler oci://ghcr.io/cnoe-io/charts/scheduler --version 0.5.68

# Upgrade an existing release
helm upgrade scheduler oci://ghcr.io/cnoe-io/charts/scheduler --version 0.5.68
```

## Customizing Values

Override default values using `--set` flags or a custom values file:

```bash
# Override individual values
helm install scheduler oci://ghcr.io/cnoe-io/charts/scheduler --version 0.5.68 \
  --set replicaCount=2

# Use a custom values file
helm install scheduler oci://ghcr.io/cnoe-io/charts/scheduler --version 0.5.68 \
  -f custom-values.yaml

# Show all configurable values
helm show values oci://ghcr.io/cnoe-io/charts/scheduler --version 0.5.68
```
